records.name: Waltham Butternut
records.description: Reliable butternut with dense flesh and a small seed cavity. The common parent of both lines.

records.name: Buttercup

records.text: Founder fruit kept 11 months in the shed at 15 to 20°C. Excellent keeper.
Vines reached 8 m. Needs a strong trellis.

records.name: Pantry Keeper
records.goal: A sweet, dense squash that keeps for a year in an ordinary shed, on a vine small enough for a suburban garden. Example project: everything here is made up.

goals.statement: A sweet, dense squash that keeps for a year in an ordinary shed.
goals.inScope: C. moschata only. Butternut and cheese-pumpkin types. Home garden conditions.
goals.outScope: C. maxima and C. pepo crosses. Giant fruit.
goals.success: An F5 line that reliably keeps 12 months and scores 4+ on flavour.

goals.statement: A sweet, dense squash that keeps for a year in an ordinary shed, on a vine small enough for a suburban garden.
goals.inScope: C. moschata only. Butternut and cheese-pumpkin types. Suburban garden: vines under about 3 m.
goals.outScope: C. maxima and C. pepo crosses. Giant fruit. Vines that need a paddock.
goals.success: An F5 line that keeps 12 months, scores 4+ on flavour and fits a 3 m bed.
goals.reason: Line T showed how much vine size matters in a small garden, so compact vine became a stated target.

records.name: Line LI (storage and flavour)
records.goal: Waltham Butternut × Long Island Cheese. Keep the butternut shape and small cavity, add Long Island Cheese storage and sweetness.

records.name: Line T (vigour and production)
records.goal: Waltham Butternut × Tromboncino. Add vigour and production, then select hard for a smaller vine.

records.text: Plan: two lines that share Waltham Butternut. Self each line to F2, select, then combine the best of both.
F2 harvest done. Line LI has the keepers so far; Line T is productive but vines are still too big. Crossed the best of each line.

records.notes: Older seed slowing down. Time to grow some out.
Female flower taped shut the evening before, pollinated at 7am.
Expected: Buttercup is C. maxima, Waltham is C. moschata.
